deck_title: Wien-Planck lambda_peak = b_Wien / T blackbody spectral displacement law vs naive fixed-hue emissive multiplier rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Wilhelm Wien (1893, Nobel Prize 1911) & Max Planck (1900) blackbody thermal radiation displacement law (solving the Planck extremum x*e^x/(e^x - 1) = 5 -> x = 4.965114 so lambda_peak(T) = b_Wien / T = lambda_0 / (1 + u), locking lambda_active / lambda_Wien = 1.0000x across all 17 temperature stations u = T/T_0 - 1 in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive fixed-hue emissive multiplier shader (keeping lambda = lambda_0 while scaling brightness, which drifts from Wien’s peak wavelength by T/T_0 = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-band Planck spectral scaling quadrature.
